problem:
The equation of the hyperbola $18{x}^{2}-5{y}^{2}=90$ in standard form is{{field-1}}
$=1.$
worked_solution:
The Cartesian equation of a horizontal hyperbola centered at the origin is

$$
\frac{{x}^{2}}{{a}^{2}}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{{b}^{2}}=1.
$$

Therefore, to write the equation of the hyperbola in standard form, we need to divide both sides of the equation by $90$ and then simplify, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}18{x}^{2}-5{y}^{2} & =90 \\ \frac{18{x}^{2}}{90}-\frac{5{y}^{2}}{90} & =\frac{90}{90} \\ \frac{{x}^{2}}{5}-\frac{{y}^{2}}{18} & =1\end{aligned}
$$
